title: AI Movie Credits Generator
summary: Make end credits for your film with AI. Copy one of 10 movie credits templates, add your names, and Flick makes the clip. Try it free.
body_markdown:
### What should I put in short film credits?


Include the director, writer, producers, cast, key crew, music and any locations or people you want to thank, and add licences for the music you used. Check how each person wants their name to appear before you lock the card.


### How long should end credits be?


Long enough to read every name at a comfortable pace, which for a short film is often well under a minute. A list that scrolls too fast to read fails the people it is meant to credit, so slow it down or use fewer names per card.


### What is the difference between a credit crawl and title cards?


A crawl rolls one long list of names up the screen, while title cards show a few names at a time and then change. Short films with few names often suit title cards, and a long crew list suits a crawl.


### Can I make movie credits for free?


Yes, you can start free: you get 100 credits when you sign up, 200 more for joining the Flick Discord, and 100 credits every week. The looks on this page used GPT Image 2.5 and MiniMax H3 Fast, which both run on the free plan, and downloads carry a Flick watermark until the Standard plan.


### Can AI get the names right in credits?


Often, but read every letter, since image and video models can still misspell or warp small text. Large type, short lists and a card with a few names at a time give the most reliable results.
